title: Commonwealth Bank reverses AI voice-bot job cuts and admits assessment error
summary: Commonwealth Bank reversed job cuts it had made after introducing a voice bot on its inbound customer enquiries line, saying its initial assessment "did not adequately consider all relevant business considerations" and that the roles were therefore not redundant; the cuts had covered 90 jobs in total, including 45 roles in direct banking, and the bank apologised to the affected employees. The Finance Sector Union called the reversal a win for workers and said the bank had tried to present job cuts as innovation, and affected staff were offered a choice between staying in their roles, redeployment within the bank, or leaving.
